verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcast docs cover the full loop: drafting or scheduling a broadcast to all or a subset of subscribers, targeting by segment or tag IDs, and setting subject, HTML content, preview text, email template and `send_at` schedule, with update and delete endpoints. Pricing lists unlimited broadcasts and audience tagging and segmentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the send and schedule flow works, and fuller documentation of the in-app visual email composer beyond brief editor and collaborative-editing mentions.
